title: STNFS with 150k pool, both-bars alpha (5.15, 0.85), theta 2881/8000, slacks (295, 226), UDUP 0.65, pr sub-bins, reopt plan, rels - 2 SE, 12-relation skewed boot: 121.077749721774

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm in proof.md and DESCENT.md with the REFINEMENT.md refinements, 99.9% ECM, X2 = 2^64, theta = 2881/8000 collection on a 150,000-draw pool (proof.md), the measured record route and the STORAGE.md/row_tail.c kernels returns Q satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P, with success at least 0.4969 (and hence at least 0.39) under disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (with H4u: at least 88% of the filtered matrix row weight is +-1 entries). It computes two GT logarithms and returns Q=[a]Q0, handling z=1 directly. All classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^121.077749721774 dense-Fp12 units, C=20,000 instructions; the upper-rounded ledger rows sum to 2^121.0777497217737498 (70-digit decimal arithmetic), below the declared 2^121.077749721774. ECM succeeds with 99.9% per prime; X2 = 2^64; theta=2881/8000 (6628 rows, a-radius 869) with slacks (295, 226), allowance 1.0263, alpha (5.15, 0.85), primes in [2^63, 2^64) charged twice, records routed at 10.01 each and re-read at 7.003: collection <= 2^120.9254 units. The polynomials, factor-base bound, filtering, kernels and target remain those of the cited source; the 62-node descent plan of REFINEMENT.md/refinement.json (coordinate search with joint moves at the conservative inputs and the skewed boot, 6 entries differ from the v17 plan, boot window unchanged) is evaluated at UDUP = 0.65 and THIN_MAX 85 with the descent relation input LOG2_RELS = 63.834, the retained-count floor 63.940 minus two pool standard errors (0.0529 bits; [7s] sensitivity). Linear algebra (STORAGE.md, row_tail.c: 20.7 instructions per sparse entry, 2,710 per row for six-limb transfers, combination and the reduction mod r, 97 per dense term, 420 per further 9-limb reduction, N = 1.096 x 0.0471 U, Block Wiedemann blocks (19, 4)) is <= 2^117.7103 units, generator <= 2^107.1997. Descent integrates pr over 24+10 measured norm sub-bins (charged boost capped 4x nodes / 1.5x boot) and credits UDUP = 0.65 distinct relations per raw relation: the 52-cell relation-weighted campaign (uniform cells) gives E[shat/m] >= 4.70 x (nodes) the sextile pr at its lower confidence endpoints, hence >= 1.175 x the charged pr (4x cap); 3000 skewed-boot points on 3 certified lattices give >= 1.00 x the sextile pr and >= 0.87 x the charged pr (boost 1.16 x) at the R=4 boot, both above 0.65; the live [11] check tests 1.175 (node 220g) and 0.70 (96 fresh boot cells). The boot lattice is reduced in the weighted metric (b-block x isqrt(U)) and certified exactly there (membership, Lovasz and size conditions, Gram determinant p^12 W^12); its bins come from 3,072 exact norms on 8 such lattices. Nodes with q <= 2^90 discard relations touching an ideal without a log; the boot keeps 12 relations. Expected two-log work is bounded by 2^111.815; the two-log meter is 2^112.815; Markov abort probability is <= 0.5. Other upper bounds are boot failure 1.000e-03 per log (charged 21x the H5 model value), expected nodes 2^16.22, node abort 2^-11.08 and repeats 2^-10.70, with 2/r statistical distance charged. All preprocessing, failed attempts, advice, arithmetic, transfers, sorting, verification and output are included; nothing amortized. Numerical-certificate construction receives an extra 2^50-unit allowance. Memory is at most 2^105 bytes. Source smoothness and production extrapolations stay explicit heuristics. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, and nonzero lower/upper integration controls. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) to mean weight 100 and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).
Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger, retention, ECM, descent and declared bounds (about 50 s natively; longer when emulated).
